title: Write the Conventions section of CLAUDE.md
body: The arbitrary but fixed choices, each settled in a word: abbreviation policy (prf/seq/fwd/bwd versus full words, and where each is allowed), naming affixes (_idx, is_, with_, from_), bail! and panic messages, test naming and return type, doc line style, extension trait naming, builders by hand or derive_builder. About ten lines in CLAUDE.md. Anything rustfmt or clippy already enforces is out of scope. The conventions the code already follows are in the notes.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/415c993d
notes.text:
Conventions the code already follows (2026-09-28 survey, both crates unless stated). Counts are grep-based.

Layout: mod.rs directories, snake_case files, one concept per file (not one type). libnail splits align/ (algorithms as free functions) from align/structs/ and structs/ (types). nail has no structs layer; types sit beside their users.
Re-exports: mod.rs does private "mod x;" then "pub use x::*;" (14 of 15 submodules). lib.rs is bare "pub mod" lines, no prelude, no crate-root glob. Holdouts: libnail/src/align/mod.rs:13-27 mixes 5 named re-exports with 3 globs; structs/mod.rs exposes Profile by two paths; output/mod.rs re-exports nothing.
Imports: nail imports libnail by full path "use libnail::{..}", never a glob. Inside a crate, "use crate::{..}" grouped.
Visibility: plain pub nearly everywhere (pub(crate) at 9 sites, 8 of them in cloud.rs). Data carriers have pub fields; AdMatrixSparse and ProfileBuilder have private fields.
Errors: anyhow::Result with bail!/.context() in both crates; no crate-level error enum; thiserror for 4 leaf errors. Messages lowercase, no period, "failed to X". nail is context-heavy (71 .context, 24 .with_context); libnail is terse (bail!/anyhow! with "dimension mismatch").
main: run() -> anyhow::Result<()>; main prints "{e:?}" in red and exits 1; clap errors exit with clap's code; color_backtrace::install() at start of run.
Panics: libnail panics on impossible states (26 panic!). debug_assert! (34, libnail only) guards DP index bounds (dp_matrix.rs), NaN/finite log-sum inputs (util.rs:308-311), row-bound sentinels (row_bounds.rs:72-73). Non-test assert! is absent except mmseqs.rs:160.
Units: Nats(f32)/Bits(f32) with trait Score at API edges (forward() returns Nats); raw f32 in DP loops (393 f32/f64 mentions vs 112 Nats/Bits); f64 for p/e-values and all of stats.rs. -f32::INFINITY sentinel everywhere, never NEG_INFINITY.
DP layout: 1-based with leading pad and right pad (dp_matrix.rs:153,744,765,929). Nested core_data[state][idx], no flat strided buffer.
Indexing: typed Index keys: CoreCell M/I/D (#[repr(usize)] enum), Emission, CoreToCore, BackgroundLoop, CoreEntry, Ad, AdOffset. Matrices and Profile impl Index/IndexMut over them.
Traits: about 30. Extension traits with blanket impls are the norm (libnail util.rs: MaxAssign, MinAssign, VecMath, VecMathMut, VecUtils, LogAbuse; alphabet.rs: AminoUtilsUtf8/Digital; nail: CommandExt, FileExt, PathExt, ReadSeekExt, ByteBufferExt). dyn only in nail (3 sites: Box<dyn CloudSearchStage>, Box<dyn AlignStage>, Vec<Box<dyn PipelineOutput>>). libnail has no dyn.
Sharing: Arc<Mutex> for the output sink (search.rs:157) and db index (database.rs:430,525); Arc<[AtomicU64; N]> counters in stats.rs; ThreadLocal<RefCell<Pipeline>> with a clone per thread (search.rs:206-215), which is why stages need DynClone. rayon only in nail (23 par_iter uses; impl_rayon.rs hand-implements Producer). libnail threads &mut (175 uses), 10 clones total.
Naming: _idx not _index (about 1262 vs 0); is_ predicates (is_valid, is_empty, is_default, is_core_state), no has_; bare field access, get_/set_ only on DP matrix accessors (dp_matrix.rs:390-419); with_* on builders; set_* on stats. new() takes sizes or &SearchArgs and returns Result when fallible (about 22 uses); from_<source> for conversions (from_utf8, from_digital, from_cloud, from_path, from_blosum_62_and_seq). Loop indices are named (profile_idx, target_idx, state_idx, ad_idx); bare i/j is rare (7 total). Lifetimes only 'a and '_. Generics: P: AsRef<Path>, W: Write, R: Read/BufRead, T for blanket impls, M for matrices, const C/N.
Control flow: ? chains dominate; match over if let (33 vs 5 in align); expression tails over early return; no let-else anywhere.
Loops: DP recurrences use range loops with named indices (49 in align/ vs 8 enumerate, 13 zip); IO and pipeline use iterators (3 range loops total).
Strings: impl Display for one-line values (Sequence, Profile, Alphabet, Bound, Seed, CloudSearchParams, FileFormat); *_string() for multi-line or tabular output (ali_string, vert_string, stat_string, serial_string, doc_string, field_string).
Constants: const items (142, 96 in libnail); consts modules for byte tags (mmseqs.rs:24); function-local consts for tolerances; needleman_wunsch.rs:61-63 module-level scoring consts. CloudSearchParams::default hardcodes 12.0/20.0.
Constructors and builders: hand-written builders in libnail (AlignmentBuilder with with_* setters, ProfileBuilder via ::default()); derive_builder in nail (3 stage configs, #[builder(setter(strip_option), default)]). Default derived on about 25 types, hand-written for non-zero defaults (about 6).
Derives: small types are Copy (about 19); common sets Default+Clone, Debug+Clone+Default on clap Args, Clone+Copy+EnumIter+EnumCount on stats enums. Debug hand-written on Nats, Bits, Cell, Bound, RowBounds, Sequence, CoreToCore, BoundIter. No serde.
unsafe: 6 sites, each with a lowercase "// safety:" comment and an RFC link (alphabet.rs:56, dp_matrix.rs:33,47,415,420, database.rs:31). No get_unchecked.
Perf: shrink_to_fit after building (12), #[inline]/#[inline(always)] 35 (26 in dp_matrix.rs), with_capacity 6. log_add is a table-driven f32 approximation built in f64 (util.rs:293-304). log_sum! and max_f32! macros.
Docs: /// one-liners (libnail 346, nail 99), capitalized, no period (8% have one), no # Examples/# Panics/# Errors, no //! module docs, no doctests. ASCII cloud diagrams in /// blocks. About 1 doc line per pub item in libnail, fewer in nail.
Comments: lowercase, no period, above the line. 19 TODOs, lowercase questions ("why does this ..."), 5 in dp_matrix.rs. HMMER references informal (about 20). Section banners "// ---- 1-byte delim ----" in database.rs.
Tests: #[cfg(test)] mod tests at file bottom (12 blocks, 10 files), no tests/ dir, no benches, about 38 tests. Most return anyhow::Result<()> and use ?. macro_rules! generators for table-driven cases (fasta.rs:132, impl_rayon.rs:134, p7hmm.rs:336, database.rs:617). Fixtures via Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../fixtures/..."). #[ctor] installs color_backtrace (util.rs:35). No #[should_panic].
Features: debug gates whole modules by cfg attr (libnail util.rs:351, cloud.rs:965; dep:image); jemalloc gates the global allocator (main.rs:19). No cfg!() inline.
Deps of note: anyhow and thiserror in both crates; color-backtrace is a normal dep in nail, dev-only in libnail; strum and strum_macros both declared; dyn-clone, derive_builder, indexmap, thread_local, rayon in nail; seq_io, phf, regex, lazy_static, rand, rand_pcg, datasize in libnail.
